title: Minimum Path Sum Grid - Solution
intuition: Given a m x n grid filled with non-negative numbers, find a path from top left to bottom right, which minimizes the sum of all numbers along its path.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Initialize boundaries (first row/column) as cumulative sums. For other cells: grid[i][j] + min(top, left).
